[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]] states that it begins one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the events of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''The Prisoner of Bogan'']] arc, which in turn states it picks up two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after ''Force Storm''. Thus, ''Force War'' occurs in [[25,792 BBY]], and the battle for [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] occurs sometime between [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 5]] and ''Force War'' 1.</ref>

{{Quote|They savaged the outpost at Furies Gate, then took the Giants—Obri and Mawr and their moons—before we blunted their attack on Tython itself.|[[Je'daii Master]] [[Daegen Lok]]'s log|<ref name="DOTJ 11" />}}
Sometime between [[25,793 BBY|25,793]] and [[25,792 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> after [[Capture of Obri|capturing]] [[Capture of Mawr|the]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Obri]] and [[Mawr]] during their [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] '''attacked''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], as [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] hoped to secure the [[Infinity Gate]] rumored to exist there. However, the [[Je'daii Order]] repelled the Rakatan assault. Forced back, the Infinite Empire [[Fall of Ska Gora|captured]] the planet [[Ska Gora]] instead.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Tython was mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]], written by [[John Ostrander]] and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[November 20]], [[2013]].<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
